remarks: Ideally located in one of the most desirable settings within the community, this first-floor condominium offers a rare combination of convenience, comfort, and value.   From the front of the unit, enjoy direct views of the pool and clubhouse, while the rear patio opens to a beautifully maintained, expansive green lawn, creating a peaceful outdoor space to relax and enjoy.  The functional layout is filled with natural light and offers comfortable living for first-time homebuyers, those looking to downsize, or buyers seeking a property with long-term value. The first-floor location provides easy, stair-free access, making everyday living effortless.    Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer, assigned parking conveniently located directly in front of the building, and **HOA includes heat and hot water**, adding exceptional value and helping simplify monthly expenses.  Ideally situated near Metro-North, I-95, Route 7, shopping, dining, parks, and Norwalk's waterfront, this home offers outstanding convenience for both commuting and everyday living.    A premium location within the community, desirable amenities, generous outdoor green space, and low-maintenance living make this an exceptional opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.
